sentences.en: The cutting of huge figures or ‘geoglyphs’ into the earth of English hillsides has taken place for more than 3,000 years.
sentences.zh: 人们在英格兰山坡的地面上刻出巨大图案，也叫“地画”，这种做法已有三千多年历史。

sentences.en: There are 56 hill figures scattered around England, with the vast majority on the chalk downlands of the country’s southern counties.
sentences.zh: 英格兰各地散布着56幅山坡图案，绝大多数位于英格兰南部各郡的白垩丘陵上。

sentences.en: The figures include giants, horses, crosses and regimental badges.
sentences.zh: 图案有巨人、马、十字架，还有军团徽章。

sentences.en: Although the majority of these geoglyphs date within the last 300 years or so, there are one or two that are much older.
sentences.zh: 这些地画大多刻于过去约三百年间，但有一两幅的年代要久远得多。

sentences.en: The most famous of these figures is perhaps also the most mysterious — the Uffington White Horse in Oxfordshire.
sentences.zh: 其中最著名的图案也许也最为神秘，便是位于牛津郡的乌芬顿白马。

sentences.en: The White Horse has recently been re-dated and shown to be even older than its previously assigned ancient pre-Roman Iron Age* date.
sentences.zh: 白马地画最近经过重新测年。人们原先认定它作于罗马人到来之前的铁器时代*，如今看来，其年代更加久远。

sentences.en: More controversial is the date of the enigmatic Long Man of Wilmington in Sussex.
sentences.zh: 萨塞克斯郡那幅谜一般的“威尔明顿长人”地画作于何时，更有争议。

sentences.en: While many historians are convinced the figure is prehistoric, others believe that it was the work of an artistic monk from a nearby priory and was created between the 11th and 15th centuries.
sentences.zh: 不少历史学家确信这是史前图案；但也有人认为，它是附近一座修道院里一位擅长艺术的修士在11世纪至15世纪之间创作的。

sentences.en: The method of cutting these huge figures was simply to remove the overlying grass to reveal the gleaming white chalk below.
sentences.zh: 刻出这些巨大图案的方法十分简单：除去表面覆盖的草皮，露出下方洁白发亮的白垩。

sentences.en: However, the grass would soon grow over the geoglyph again unless it was regularly cleaned or scoured by a fairly large team of people.
sentences.zh: 不过，除非有相当多的人定期清理、刮除草皮，否则青草很快就会再次盖住地画。

sentences.en: One reason that the vast majority of hill figures have disappeared is that when the traditions associated with the figures faded, people no longer bothered or remembered to clear away the grass to expose the chalk outline.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数山坡图案已经消失，其中一个原因是，与图案有关的传统一旦衰微，人们便懒得或忘了清除草皮，让白垩勾出的轮廓重新显露。

sentences.en: Furthermore, over hundreds of years the outlines would sometimes change due to people not always cutting in exactly the same place, thus creating a different shape to the original geoglyph.
sentences.zh: 此外，几百年间，人们每次铲草的位置并不总是分毫不差，因此轮廓有时会变，逐渐形成与原地画不同的形状。

sentences.en: The fact that any ancient hill figures survive at all in England today is testament to the strength and continuity of local customs and beliefs which, in one case at least, must stretch back over millennia.
sentences.zh: 如今英格兰竟还有古老的山坡图案留存，足见当地习俗和信仰的生命力，以及它们世代相传的延续性；其中至少有一例可以追溯数千年。

sentences.en: The Uffington White Horse is a unique, stylised representation of a horse consisting of a long, sleek back, thin disjointed legs, a streaming tail, and a bird-like beaked head.
sentences.zh: 乌芬顿白马用独特的装饰化手法描绘了一匹马：背部修长流畅，四肢纤细、彼此断开，马尾飘扬，马头呈鸟喙状。

sentences.en: The elegant creature almost melts into the landscape.
sentences.zh: 这匹姿态优雅的马几乎融入了周围的景色。

sentences.en: The horse is situated 2.5 km from Uffington village on a steep slope close to the Late Bronze Age* (c. 7th century BCE) hillfort of Uffington Castle and below the Ridgeway, a long-distance Neolithic** track.
sentences.zh: 白马位于距乌芬顿村2.5公里的一处陡坡上，靠近青铜时代晚期*（约公元前7世纪）的山堡乌芬顿堡，其上方是里奇韦古道，一条新石器时代**的长途道路。

sentences.en: The Uffington Horse is also surrounded by Bronze Age burial mounds.
sentences.zh: 乌芬顿白马的周围还有青铜时代的墓冢。

sentences.en: It is not far from the Bronze Age cemetery of Lambourn Seven Barrows, which consists of more than 30 well-preserved burial mounds.
sentences.zh: 白马离青铜时代的兰伯恩七冢墓地不远，那片墓地有三十多座保存完好的墓冢。

sentences.en: The carving has been placed in such a way as to make it extremely difficult to see from close quarters, and like many geoglyphs is best appreciated from the air.
sentences.zh: 这幅地画所处的位置使人近看时极难看清全貌；像许多地画一样，它最好从空中欣赏。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, there are certain areas of the Vale of the White Horse, the valley containing and named after the enigmatic creature, from which an adequate impression may be gained.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，在白马谷的某些地方，还是能大致看清图案的样子。这个山谷正是因谷中这匹神秘的马而得名。

sentences.en: Indeed on a clear day the carving can be seen from up to 30 km away.
sentences.zh: 事实上，天气晴朗时，最远在30公里外就能看到这幅地画。

sentences.en: The earliest evidence of a horse at Uffington is from the 1070s CE when ‘White Horse Hill’ is mentioned in documents from the nearby Abbey of Abingdon, and the first reference to the horse itself is soon after, in 1190 CE.
sentences.zh: 乌芬顿有白马的最早证据来自公元1070年代，当时附近阿宾登修道院的文献提到了“白马山”。而第一次明确提到白马图案本身是在此后不久的公元1190年。

sentences.en: However, the carving is believed to date back much further than that.
sentences.zh: 不过，人们认为这幅地画的起源要比这早得多。

sentences.en: Due to the similarity of the Uffington White Horse to the stylised depictions of horses on 1st century BCE coins, it had been thought that the creature must also date to that period.
sentences.zh: 由于乌芬顿白马与公元前1世纪钱币上风格化的马形图案相似，人们曾认为白马也一定出自那个时期。

sentences.en: However, in 1995 Optically Stimulated Luminescence (OSL) testing was carried out by the Oxford Archaeological Unit on soil from two of the lower layers of the horse’s body, and from another cut near the base.
sentences.zh: 然而，1995年，牛津考古队采用光释光（OSL）法测年，检测了马身下部两个土层的土样，以及靠近地画底部另一处切口的土样。

sentences.en: The result was a date for the horse’s construction somewhere between 1400 and 600 BCE — in other words, it had a Late Bronze Age or Early Iron Age origin.
sentences.zh: 测定结果表明，白马图案刻于公元前1400年至公元前600年之间；换句话说，它起源于青铜时代晚期或铁器时代早期。

sentences.en: The latter end of this date range would tie the carving of the horse in with occupation of the nearby Uffington hillfort, indicating that it may represent a tribal emblem marking the land of the inhabitants of the hillfort.
sentences.zh: 如果取这个年代范围较晚的一端，刻画白马的时间就与附近乌芬顿山堡有人居住的时间吻合。这表明它可能是部落的徽记，用来标示山堡居民的领地。

sentences.en: Alternatively, the carving may have been carried out during a Bronze or Iron Age ritual.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是，这幅地画是在青铜时代或铁器时代的某次仪式中刻成的。

sentences.en: Some researchers see the horse as representing the Celtic*** horse goddess Epona, who was worshipped as a protector of horses, and for her associations with fertility.
sentences.zh: 有学者认为，这匹马代表凯尔特人***的马女神埃波娜，人们崇拜她，是因为她是马的保护者，也因为她与生育有关。

sentences.en: However, the cult of Epona was not imported from Gaul (France) until around the first century CE.
sentences.zh: 可是，对埃波娜的崇拜直到公元1世纪前后才从高卢（今法国）传入。

sentences.en: This date is at least six centuries after the Uffington Horse was probably carved.
sentences.zh: 这一时间比推测的乌芬顿白马刻成年代至少晚六个世纪。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the horse had great ritual and economic significance during the Bronze and Iron Ages, as attested by its depictions on jewellery and other metal objects.
sentences.zh: 然而，青铜时代和铁器时代的马具有重要的仪式和经济意义，首饰和其他金属器物上的马形图案便是明证。

sentences.en: It is possible that the carving represents a goddess in native mythology, such as Rhiannon, described in later Welsh mythology as a beautiful woman dressed in gold and riding a white horse.
sentences.zh: 这幅地画也可能代表本土神话中的一位女神，比如里安农；在后世的威尔士神话中，里安农是位身着金衣、骑着白马的美丽女子。

sentences.en: The fact that geoglyphs can disappear easily, along with their associated rituals and meaning, indicates that they were never intended to be anything more than temporary gestures.
sentences.zh: 地画连同相关的仪式和意义都很容易消失。这表明人们最初所追求的，只是借它们作一时的表达。

sentences.en: But this does not lessen their importance.
sentences.zh: 但这丝毫不减损它们的重要性。

sentences.en: These giant carvings are a fascinating glimpse into the minds of their creators and how they viewed the landscape in which they lived.
sentences.zh: 这些巨型地画引人入胜，让我们得以窥见创作者的内心，以及他们看待周围生活环境的方式。
